newsitem.title: UK: UK meals/feeds attracted light seasonal trade.
newsitem.headline: UK meals/feeds attracted light seasonal trade.

text.p: UK meals and feeds brokers reported mainly light trading on Tuesday with buyers topping up supplies ahead of the end-year holiday break.
"People are buying odds and ends, just about what you would expect at this time of year," said a trader.
A.D.M. rapemeal traded at 124 stg for January ex-mill.
On the east coast, EU sunflower pellets traded at 94 stg a tonne for Dec/Jan delivery.
High protein soymeal sellers were higher following gains in Chicago with ex-mill sellers one to two stg up and stores 0.50 to two stg higher.
